how_to_read: Each race is run automatically 55-30 min before its official post. FINAL = signed pre-race Production FINAL with the 買い目 tree; EVIDENCE_NO_BET = verified zero-exposure terminal because some runner x index cells could not be closed from official evidence; AKI_NO_BET = actual Full20 closed, registered AKI positive-evidence selection cannot close; MISSED_WINDOW = never predicted (no late or backdated FINAL). state retains scheduler compatibility; display_state and post_result_evidence separate stored bodies/bindings from signature verification and full closure.
